Monthly OS NGD orders represent data as at the first day of the month rather than the order date

Temporal snapshots requested earlier than a feature schema launch date may contain inconsistencies and cannot be treated as authoritative historic reconstructions
OS does not recommend using OS NGD Address Theme data to incrementally update an AddressBase holding because formats and attribution have no direct reverse mapping
